'''Collar lights''' were hands-free illumination tools used during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They were considered an improvement over standard [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]].

==Behind the scenes==
This item can only be obtained in the computer version of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' by using a cheat code. It, along with the [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] and torch, is unique in its ability to be a light source when activated.
